tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page and table background. `foreground` and `muted-foreground` read on it.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text, on `background`, `card` and `popover`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card, table container and panel surface.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, Select content, Tooltip and toast surface.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one brand colour: primary buttons, active nav item, selected checkbox, links. Never used for status. As text it reads on `background` and `card`.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label text and icons on a `primary` fill.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and neutral badges (Submitted, Credit).

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: table header band, skeleton blocks, disabled inputs, Withdrawn badge.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: emails under names, captions, table headers, helper text. Reads on `background`, `card`, `muted` and `sidebar`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons, menu items and nav items.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons (Withdraw, Withhold confirm) and form error text/borders. Not a status colour — status uses the status-* tokens.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Label text on a `destructive` fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rows, card edges, separators. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input, Select and Textarea borders. 3:1 against `background`, `card` and `muted` so the control boundary is visible (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every focusable element. ≥3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Left navigation surface.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Nav item text on `sidebar`.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active nav item indicator / fill.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary`.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered and current nav item fill.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-accent`.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar edge and group separators.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Paid, Published, Enrolled — quiet positive. Soft badge only (subtle fill), never a solid fill. As text, AA on `background`, `card`, `muted` and `status-success-subtle`.

tokens.name: status-success-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `status-success` fill. AA on it in both themes.

tokens.name: status-success-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background of the soft success badge, row tint and Alert; `status-success` text reads on it.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Deferred (outline), Needs re-publish (soft), warning Alerts. As text, AA on `background`, `card`, `muted` and `status-warning-subtle`.

tokens.name: status-warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `status-warning` fill. AA on it in both themes.

tokens.name: status-warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background of the soft warning badge, row tint and Alert; `status-warning` text reads on it.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Extension (soft badge, new date in tooltip) and info Alerts. Blue, kept apart from the teal `primary`. As text, AA on `background`, `card`, `muted` and `status-info-subtle`.

tokens.name: status-info-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `status-info` fill. AA on it in both themes.

tokens.name: status-info-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background of the soft info badge, row tint and Alert; `status-info` text reads on it.

tokens.name: status-overdue
tokens.usage: Overdue fees — the strongest red in the app. SOLID badge with days count ("Overdue · 21 days"); overdue amounts in tables. As text, AA on `background`, `card`, `muted` and `status-overdue-subtle`.

tokens.name: status-overdue-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `status-overdue` fill. AA on it in both themes.

tokens.name: status-overdue-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background of the soft overdue badge, row tint and Alert; `status-overdue` text reads on it.

tokens.name: status-late
tokens.usage: Late submissions — destructive meaning, soft red badge with time late ("Late · 1d 3h"). As text, AA on `background`, `card`, `muted` and `status-late-subtle`.

tokens.name: status-late-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `status-late` fill. AA on it in both themes.

tokens.name: status-late-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background of the soft late badge, row tint and Alert; `status-late` text reads on it.

tokens.name: status-withheld
tokens.usage: Withheld results — solid orange badge, always paired with a reason chip. As text, AA on `background`, `card`, `muted` and `status-withheld-subtle`.

tokens.name: status-withheld-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `status-withheld` fill. AA on it in both themes.

tokens.name: status-withheld-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background of the soft withheld badge, row tint and Alert; `status-withheld` text reads on it.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page, top-left of the content area. text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Card titles, tab section headings, Dialog titles. text-base font-semibold.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Submissions are closed because your enrolment status is Withdrawn. Contact Registry.
styles.usage: Default UI text, table cells, form values. text-sm.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Form labels, student names in rows, button labels. text-sm font-medium.

styles.name: table-header
styles.usage: Table column headers in `muted-foreground`, sentence case, never uppercase. text-xs font-medium.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Changes apply to new charges only.
styles.usage: Helper text, error messages, badge text, timestamps under names. text-xs.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Student IDs, payment references, money and dates in tables. font-mono text-[13px] tabular-nums; right-align money.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: IDs and references inside badges, captions and receipts. font-mono text-xs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in badges; gap between label and input.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; table cell horizontal padding is space-3.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding, Alert padding-y, toast padding-y.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (dense), form field vertical rhythm, Alert padding-x.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter, Dialog padding, gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above a page title from the top bar; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, reason chips, checkboxes. calc(var(--radius) - 4px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, menu items. calc(var(--radius) - 2px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, table containers, Alerts, Dialogs, toasts. = --radius (0.5rem). Nothing is rounder.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Table body row height (h-10). Header row is 36px.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inline row actions (h-7).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, selects (h-8) — the Nova compact size.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons; student mobile primary actions (h-9).

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Slim top bar (h-12) holding the role switcher.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Left nav width at 1440px (w-56).

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons (outline), inputs.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, toasts only. Cards and tables are flat with a `border`.
